$comment: Hand-curated review of design/assets/images. Alt text is a draft for staff to check. 'exclude' records why an asset must not be imported. 'usedByReference' lists the reference pages that showed the image; when two images are near-duplicates, a referenced one is kept. Rights stay UNCONFIRMED until the client confirms ownership or licence.
